mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous component of your course."
The TMA is a continuous component of your course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a house, and its inspection should follow the systematic procedure of sanitary inspection of a residential building."
A hotel is a house, and its inspection should follow the systematic procedure of sanitary inspection of a residential building.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the oldest single approach to physical health, mental and social well-being of man."
Exercise is the oldest single approach to physical health, mental and social well-being of man.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of materials that cannot be conveniently accommodated in the body of the report. (x) Footnotes: It is placed at the bottom of the pages in the body of a report as reference material."

Appendix is made up of materials that cannot be conveniently accommodated in the body of the report. (x) Footnotes: It is placed at the bottom of the pages in the body of a report as reference material.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those rules and regulations intended to guide peoples' behaviour."
Public health laws are those rules and regulations intended to guide peoples' behaviour.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any place where food is produced either in its natural form, stored, served, preserved or prepared, exposed for sale or served for human consumption."
A food premises is any place where food is produced either in its natural form, stored, served, preserved or prepared, exposed for sale or served for human consumption.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are referred to as residential houses."
Non- regulated premises are referred to as residential houses.
fib: ______ means the act of looking closely at something/somebody, especially to check that everything is satisfactory or to carry out an examination of something/somebody.
An inspection means the act of looking closely at something/somebody, especially to check that everything is satisfactory or to carry out an examination of something/somebody.
______ is a fundamental oversight function of an environmental health officer.
Sanitary inspection of premises is a fundamental oversight function of an environmental health officer.
______ is a list of all sources that were actually cited in a report where a bibliography consists of a listing all sources that proved useful in the execution of a study or report.
A reference is a list of all sources that were actually cited in a report where a bibliography consists of a listing all sources that proved useful in the execution of a study or report.
______ is any act, omission, place or thing which is or may be dangerous to life or injurious to health or property.
A nuisance is any act, omission, place or thing which is or may be dangerous to life or injurious to health or property.
______ is the day-to-day regular premises inspection while Incidental or Special inspection of premises is usually necessitated by a complaint or other reasons.
Routine Inspection is the day-to-day regular premises inspection while Incidental or Special inspection of premises is usually necessitated by a complaint or other reasons.

A house can be defined as a man made physical structure which is designed to meet specific purposes of man and which contributes to his healthy existence.
